settings.heading: How to care for your silver jewelry

settings.text: With the right care, your 925 sterling silver jewelry from Anima Jewels will stay beautiful for years. Follow these simple steps to keep your pieces sparkling.

settings.title: Keep it dry
settings.text: Remove your jewelry before bathing, swimming, or washing hands. Water, especially chlorinated or salty water, can speed up tarnishing.

settings.title: No chemicals
settings.text: Apply perfume, lotion, and hairspray before wearing your jewelry. Chemicals in these products react with silver and cause discoloration.

settings.title: Store properly
settings.text: Keep each piece in the anti-tarnish pouch provided, or in a soft-lined jewelry box. Store pieces individually to prevent scratching.

settings.title: Polish regularly
settings.text: Use a soft silver polishing cloth to gently buff your jewelry. This removes light tarnish and restores its shine instantly.

settings.title: Deep clean when needed
settings.text: For a deeper clean, soak in warm water with a drop of mild dish soap for 5 minutes. Scrub gently with a soft toothbrush, rinse thoroughly, and pat dry.

settings.title: Avoid these
settings.text: Never use toothpaste, baking soda, or abrasive cleaners on your silver, as they scratch the surface. Also avoid ultrasonic cleaners for gemstone-set pieces.
